road.note: road pass only. Measured 2026-10-02 from column / row dark profiles away from the title: the inner thin frame line is at x 597, y 555 (top), and y 8298 (bottom); right edge 11400 as above. 1882.furniture_note: neatline = inside the inner frame line (dark-profile at two corners), right edge pulled in to 11400 past marginal ink; furniture boxes read by eye off the 1/8 preview, 2026-10-01; masked from the river pass

1898.legend_note: swatch interiors, 11 px inset from the frame lines (x 15229-15498; y 8380-8458, 8514-8592, 8650-8727, 8786-8865, 8924-9001), read off the native legend 2026-10-02: ink = service-local black hatch, blue = military and marine, paper = non affectees (blank), green = communales, salmon = particulieres
1898.ruling_note: machine ruling measured 2026-10-02 on calibrate windows and unblinded land: every ruled cell is 5.9-6.0 px at 45 deg (image axes, lines running down-right), salmon, blue, green and grey alike (225 of 245 strong cells in a 1200x1000 land crop; 4.48/5.09/3.55 and 144 deg on 1882). 2.95 is the second harmonic (building fills), not a separate pitch. structure: 1898 hatches landing stages and buildings in neutral black (OD blue/red about 1.0, at 45 and 135 deg) while water is blue ink (bank band 0.2-0.6), so dark neutral hatch closed into a body (r 4, opened r 6) is a structure and is cut out of the water; 1882 hatches both in the same blue ink and has no such key
1898.furniture_note: four-line frame (thick, medium, two thin); the sheet is tilted and keystoned (innermost line: left x 679-692, right x 15635-15642, top y 646 at the left to 785 at the right, bottom y 14250 at the left to 14181 at the middle), so neatline is the axis-aligned box inside all four innermost-line positions, 8 px in. The title (to the Echelle 1/4000 line), the scale bar with its credit line and the legend are read by eye off native crops of the title and legend, 2026-10-02; the marginal Gc C 3683, NORD/OUEST/EST/SUD and printer lines lie outside the neatline. Heldout boxes were blacked out in the whole-sheet preview used

layer_rule: layer = water (default) or road. Water windows: trace class water. Road windows: trace every NON-road face as class block, extended past the window edge; road is the rest. ignore works in both.
split_rule: calibrate = may be used to fit the appearance model and tune the method. heldout = never looked at by a method or threshold, scored once. seen = already used in a 2026-10-01 diagnostic, so it is NOT clean held-out even if listed there.
